core_problem_solved: To provide the core implementation of the FEST fluent assertion library for Java.
key_features: Contained the core assertion logic and fluent API for the FEST-Assert library.
era_and_niche: The core module of the pioneering FEST-Assert library, upon which other modules were built.
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **obsolete**. It was superseded by its official and complete rewrite, **AssertJ** (`org.assertj:assertj-core`), which is the modern standard for fluent assertions in Java.
